newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH SHARES END JUST UP, GREENSPAN CRUSHES GAINS.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH SHARES END JUST UP, GREENSPAN CRUSHES GAINS.

text.p: 1540 GMT - Greenspan's comments crush early afternoon gains,
but Dutch market just resilient enough to set new closing peak.
Star turns in the afternoon from Unilever and companies
reporting their full year results lift the market out of a
slumber to a new record intra-day high.

* Gist up 3.00 guilders after 10 pct profit rise.
* Hagemeyer up 2.60 guilders after 47.5 pct net
